dedupe_keys.name: real operational labeled data of air handling units from office auditorium and hospital buildings

description: Real operational labeled data of air handling units from office, auditorium, and hospital buildings is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Seunghyeon Wang. This study aims to develop real operational datasets from three distinct building types (a large-scale office, an auditorium, and a hospital) focusing on Air Handling Units (AHUs) equipped with Constant Air Volume (CAV) systems for Automated Fault Detection and Diagnosis (AFDD). Coverage: a single site or case study; published in 2025. Formats: CSV. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 30690762 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support emergency-service and public-facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
